title: 考研英语第二批原创种子题（阅读/完形/翻译/写作）
scopeNote: 全部为原创编写，短文与题目均为自编，不照搬任何真题原文。阅读、完形为客观题系统判分；翻译、写作为主观题，由大模型自动评分。

questions.stem:
阅读下面短文，回答问题。

My name is Lucy. I am a student at Sunshine University. I like reading books and playing tennis. Every Sunday I go to the library with my friends.

根据短文，Lucy 每个星期天去哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句明确说 Every Sunday I go to the library，故选 A。

questions.stem:
阅读短文：

Tom is a doctor. He works in a big hospital in the city. He is very busy, but he likes helping sick people. His wife, Mary, is a teacher.

What does Mary do?
questions.explanation: 短文末句说 His wife, Mary, is a teacher，故 Mary 是老师，选 B。

questions.stem:
阅读短文：

The earth is getting warmer. Many scientists think this is because people burn too much coal and oil. We should save energy to protect our planet.

Why is the earth getting warmer according to the passage?

options.content: Because people burn too much coal and oil

questions.explanation: 短文第二句明确给出原因：people burn too much coal and oil，选 B。

questions.stem:
阅读短文：

A small boy saw a dog on the road. The dog looked lost. The boy took it home and gave it some food. The next day, the dog's owner came and said thank you.

What did the boy do for the dog?

options.content: He took it home and fed it

questions.explanation: 短文说 The boy took it home and gave it some food，即带回家并喂食，选 B。

questions.stem:
完形填空（选出能填入空白处的最佳选项）：

It was raining heavily, ___ he took a taxi to the station.
questions.explanation: 前句说雨下得很大，后句说所以他打车去车站，二者为因果关系，用 so（所以）。选 C。

questions.stem:
完形填空（选出能填入空白处的最佳选项）：

She is good ___ math, so she always gets high marks.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be good at 表示“擅长”，故选 A。

questions.stem:
请将下列英文翻译成中文：

Knowledge is power, and reading is the best way to gain knowledge.
questions.answer: 知识就是力量，而阅读是获取知识的最好方式。
questions.explanation: 评分要点：准确译出 Knowledge is power（知识就是力量）；reading is the best way to gain knowledge 译出“阅读是获取知识的最好/最佳方式”；语句通顺、无重大误译。

questions.stem:
请将下列英文翻译成中文：

Where there is a will, there is a way.
questions.explanation: 评分要点：译文达意，体现“有意志就有方法”的含义；鼓励使用成语“有志者事竟成”。

questions.stem:
请将下列英文翻译成中文：

It is important for college students to make a good study plan before the exam.
questions.answer: 对大学生来说，在考试前制定一个好的学习计划是很重要的。
questions.explanation: 评分要点：翻译出 it is important for... to...（对……来说……很重要）；study plan 译为“学习计划”；整体语句通顺。

questions.stem: 英语写作：以 'My Favorite Hobby' 为题写一篇不少于 80 词的英语短文，介绍你最喜欢的爱好及原因。
questions.answer:
参考范文要点：1) 开头点明爱好（如 reading / sports / music）；2) 说明开始时间与频率；3) 阐述原因（放松身心、学到知识、结交朋友等）；4) 总结感受。
参考开头：My favorite hobby is reading. I have kept this habit since childhood. Every evening I spend half an hour reading novels and newspapers. Reading not only relaxes me but also teaches me a lot about the world. I think it is the best way to spend my free time.
questions.explanation: 评分要点：内容切题、结构完整（开头-主体-结尾）；语法与词汇基本正确、无明显中式英语；字数达标（≥80词）；能说明原因。

questions.stem: 英语写作：假如你是李华，你的英国笔友 Tom 来信询问中国春节的习俗，请写一封回信（不少于 80 词），介绍春节并表达欢迎。
questions.answer: 参考要点：1) 书信开头礼貌回应来信；2) 介绍春节时间（农历正月初一）与核心习俗（吃团圆饭、贴春联、守岁/放鞭炮）；3) 表达欢迎 Tom 来中国体验；4) 结尾祝福。注意书信格式与礼貌用语（Dear Tom, / Yours, Li Hua）。
questions.explanation: 评分要点：书信格式正确；内容涵盖春节时间与主要习俗；语气礼貌、有邀请之意；语法词汇基本正确、字数达标。
